content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification was released on 24 November 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications from 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM to 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Candidates must complete registration, upload the required documents and pay the applicable fee within the prescribed period. Important: The NHPC Trainee Engineer application process closes at 5:00 PM on 26 December 2026. Applications submitted after the deadline will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 205 Trainee Engineer vacancies have been announced under NHPC Recruitment 2026. The recruitment includes 64 Civil, 88 Electrical and 53 Mechanical Engineering vacancies. Of these, 188 posts are available in NHPC and 17 in NHDC Limited. Electrical Engineering has the highest number of vacancies. The official notification provides the following category-wise vacancies for Civil, Electrical and Mechanical Trainee Engineer posts in NHPC and NHDC Limited. The NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification identifies eight vacancies under horizontal reservation for eligible Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). These vacancies are included within the advertised total of 205 and are not additional posts. PwBD candidates must meet the disability-category and eligibility requirements prescribed for their selected Engineering discipline. Candidates claiming reservation must possess a valid benchmark disability certificate showing at least 40% qualifying disability.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before applying for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026, candidates should check whether they meet the educational qualification, minimum marks, age limit and GATE score requirements for their preferred Engineering discipline. A valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 score in the corresponding subject is mandatory. Final-year Engineering students are not eligible to apply. Yes, fresh Engineering graduates can apply for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 if they have completed the prescribed Engineering qualification with the required marks and possess a valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 score in the relevant paper. Previous work experience is not mandatory. However, candidates who are still appearing in their final-year Engineering examination are not eligible for this recruitment. Important: This is a quick eligibility guide and does not confirm individual eligibility. Candidates should carefully check their Engineering discipline, aggregate marks, GATE paper code, age and other requirements against the official notification.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 eligibility conditions are based on educational qualifications, valid GATE examination scores, age and reservation requirements. Candidates must possess a full-time Engineering Degree in the prescribed discipline or an eligible AMIE qualification. Only the notified Engineering disciplines and corresponding GATE paper codes are accepted. NHPC has prescribed a full-time regular Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology or B.Sc Engineering in the relevant discipline from a recognised Indian university or AICTE-approved institution. An eligible AMIE qualification with enrolment up to 31 May 2013 is also accepted. Candidates must have secured at least 60% marks, relaxed to 50% for eligible SC, ST and PwBD candidates. Candidates must have qualified in GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 and possess a valid score in the corresponding Engineering paper. Applicants who appeared in both GATE examinations must enter their best score. NHPC will use the submitted GATE score for shortlisting candidates for Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Important: Only GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 normalised marks out of 100 will be considered. Scores from any other GATE year are not valid for this recruitment. Candidates must enter their correct GATE registration number and score while applying. The maximum age limit for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 is 30 years as on 26 December 2026. Upper age relaxation is available for eligible SC, ST, OBC Non-Creamy Layer, PwBD and other specified categories according to Government rules. NHPC provides upper age relaxation to eligible reserved-category candidates and other specified groups under the applicable Government of India guidelines. Candidates claiming age relaxation must possess valid supporting certificates in the prescribed format. The additional Jammu and Kashmir domicile provision applies to eligible candidates who were ordinarily domiciled in the state between 1 January 1980 and 31 December 1989.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 application fee is Rs.708 for Unreserved, EWS and OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates, including the base fee of Rs.600 and applicable taxes. SC, ST, women, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the registration fee. Important: Additional bank or processing charges, including GST where applicable, must be borne by the applicant. The registration fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying separately for NHPC and NHDC Trainee Engineer vacancies in Electrical or Mechanical disciplines must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee for each application, unless exempted.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The NHPC Trainee Engineer Salary 2026 is based on E2 Grade with a pay scale of Rs.50,000–1,60,000 under the IDA pattern. Selected candidates will receive this pay scale during the one-year training period. On successful completion of training, they will be absorbed as Engineers in the same pay scale, with a probation period of one year. The approximate annual emoluments for a new employee are Rs.16–17 lakh. In addition to basic pay, selected employees will be eligible for Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Cafeteria Allowance, Performance Related Pay, medical facilities and social security benefits such as Provident Fund, pension and gratuity according to the applicable company rules. Note: The approximate annual emoluments of Rs.16–17 lakh are not the same as the monthly in-hand salary. Actual take-home pay will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Process 2026 consists of shortlisting through GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates with a valid score in the corresponding GATE paper will be considered for shortlisting based on the normalised marks out of 100. The final merit will be prepared using the prescribed weightage for GATE, Group Discussion and Personal Interview. NHPC will shortlist candidates based on the best valid normalised marks obtained in GATE 2025 or GATE 2026. Ordinarily, candidates up to five times the number of advertised vacancies in each category and discipline may be called for the next selection stages. If candidates have equal marks at the shortlisting boundary, all such candidates may be called according to the notification. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Group Discussion. Group Discussion carries 5% weightage in the final selection score. There is no separate qualifying cut-off for Group Discussion, but candidates must satisfy the combined minimum qualifying requirements for Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates shortlisted through GATE will also appear for a Personal Interview carrying 20% weightage. Candidates must submit the prescribed consent form and attend the selection process according to the schedule communicated by NHPC. NHPC may conduct an online or offline Psychometric Assessment for candidates shortlisted for Group Discussion and Personal Interview. The assessment results may be used as an input during the interview. Candidates must produce the required educational, category, GATE and other supporting documents during the selection process. Final empanelment will depend on the prescribed composite merit, minimum qualifying standards, document verification and other eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Weightage 2026
content_sections.text: NHPC has prescribed a combined selection weightage of 75% for GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 normalised marks, 5% for Group Discussion and 20% for Personal Interview. The final score will be calculated out of 100 using these components. Candidates must obtain the prescribed minimum qualifying percentage in the combined score of Group Discussion and Personal Interview. There is no separate minimum qualifying mark for Group Discussion alone. Candidates who do not qualify in the combined Group Discussion and Personal Interview score will not be considered for final empanelment, regardless of their GATE marks.

Selection is based on valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates must have qualified in the corresponding GATE paper before applying. Only valid GATE 2025 and GATE 2026 normalised marks out of 100 are accepted for this recruitment. content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Service Bond 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates selected under NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 must execute a service agreement and surety bond to serve the organisation for a minimum of four years, including the training period. The bond amount varies according to the candidate's category. Service Commitment: Minimum four years, including the training period. Candidates should carefully read the service bond conditions before accepting an appointment.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 must upload scanned copies of the prescribed documents through the online application portal. The documents must be clear and readable, and the information must match the details entered in the application form. Matriculation or Secondary School Certificate as Proof of Date of Birth Class 12 Marksheet or Certificate Complete Engineering Degree Mark Sheets and Qualification Certificate Valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 Scorecard Certificate Confirming Full-Time Regular Engineering Qualification, Where Required CGPA / Grade-to-Percentage Conversion Certificate, If Applicable SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS Certificate, If Applicable PwBD Disability Certificate, If Applicable Recent Passport-Size Colour Photograph Scanned Signature No Objection Certificate for Government / PSU Employees, If Applicable Other Declarations or Supporting Certificates Required Under the Notification The official notification prescribes PDF files of 100 KB to 400 KB for supporting certificates. The passport-size photograph must be uploaded in JPEG format with a file size below 50 KB, while the signature must be below 25 KB.

content_sections.text: The NHPC Trainee Engineer Apply Online 2026 process will begin on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM for 205 Civil, Electrical and Mechanical vacancies. Candidates must enter the correct GATE registration number, select the appropriate post and upload all supporting documents. Eligible candidates can submit their NHPC Trainee Engineer application forms through the official NHPC Careers website. Follow the steps below. Important: Candidates are not required to send the printed registration form or supporting documents by post. Applications will be accepted only through the prescribed online process.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Training and Job Location 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Trainee Engineers will undergo one year of training in E2 Grade with a pay scale of Rs.50,000–1,60,000. After successful completion of training, they will be absorbed as Engineers in the same pay scale and placed on probation for one year. Selected candidates may be posted at NHPC or NHDC projects, power stations, offices, joint ventures or subsidiary companies in different parts of India or abroad, according to organisational requirements.
